_README: Copy this file to paths.json at the repository root (it is git-ignored), or
point $CONTRASTIVE_PATHS_CONFIG at a copy kept elsewhere. It assigns the
directories that differ between machines; everything else about a run stays in
the experiment configuration. A command-line flag always overrides a value here.
Relative paths resolve against this file's own directory, not the working
directory, and '~' is expanded. A null value keeps the built-in default, and
keys beginning with '_' are ignored, so they can be used for notes.
_data_root: Required by anything that reads DICOM data: the mount holding train_series.csv and the train_series/<study>/<series>/*.dcm tree. No default -- this is the one setting a new machine must fill in.
_reports_csv: Study reports. Default: data/sample/train.csv, relative to the repository.
_cohort_manifest: Frozen patient-grouped cohort used when no --cohort-manifest is given. No default; leave null to require the flag.
_output_dir: Where a run writes checkpoints and metrics. Default: checkpoints/contrastive, relative to the repository.
_image_cache_dir: Optional on-disk cache of preprocessed studies, reused across runs. No default.
_train_series_mirror: Optional byte-identical local copy of <data_root>/train_series (same <study>/<series> layout). Fine-tuning rungs that draw fresh slices every epoch read training series from it instead of a slow mount. No default -- leave null to read data_root.
